answer: The registry assigns 1,000 computational units per agent to validate_trajectory; without a comet in the log, trace_signature fails. An island must isolate_shard for each agent to prove work, otherwise the isolate_shard verification fails like a missing island. If flood_pruning detects duplicate signatures, the ocean triggers an entropy_buffer penalty. An ocean of fakes costs 1,000 times more honest work than a single comet, as work is non-parallelizable.
